title: 进入高楼
task: 交代五十层高楼与警队协作，进入后只向前推进。
start: 警队已抵楼外，尚未进入。
end: 黄征进入一层通道，队长在其后，群体控制入口。
cuts: 5秒由楼外切至门内，原因是交代进入结果；其后连续跟随。
segments: 黄征与队长随四名不需独立辨识的警员趋向入口，黄征在前，队长后两米，均面向北侧入口。
黄征 and 队长 approach the northward entrance with four anonymous officers; 黄征 leads and 队长 stays two metres behind.
建筑远景，摄影机在入口南侧20米、离地2米，仰角纳入高楼完整轮廓；人物全身约画高8%，不追脸。
A static establishing long shot from twenty metres south, two metres high, tilted up to include the fifty-storey tower; full figures occupy about eight percent of frame height.
玻璃塔楼高于周围楼群，入口通道无遮挡，警队与建筑同画。
The glass tower rises above the surrounding blocks; the entrance route and the whole team remain readable.
楼内传出闷枪声，近处鞋底与装备轻碰，无可辨对白。
Muffled gunfire comes from inside, with nearby boots and gear; no intelligible dialogue.
黄征到入口前，队长仍在后，尚未重复进入。
黄征 reaches the entrance with 队长 still behind.
黄征跨过门槛朝北，队长随后；四名警员中两名留守入口、两名跟进，武器均朝行动前方。
黄征 crosses the threshold northward, followed by 队长; two officers secure the door and two follow, weapons oriented along the route.
切到门内东侧，平视全景，向北平行移动，人物全身约画高40%，保留门和走廊。
Cut to an eye-level full shot inside on the east side, tracking north parallel to the team; figures occupy about forty percent of height, with doorway and corridor visible.
入口在南后方，走廊向北伸展，无人反向朝门外进攻。
The entrance remains to the south behind them and the corridor extends north; nobody attacks back toward the entrance.
脚步由户外变成室内回响，远枪声连续。
Boots acquire an indoor echo while distant gunfire continues.
黄征越过门口，队长距其后两米。
黄征 clears the doorway with 队长 two metres behind.
黄征在北向通道前进，队长维持后方掩护，两名跟进警员沿两侧推进，无新增停步表演。
黄征 advances north; 队长 covers from behind while the two following officers move along the sides without gratuitous stops.
延续东侧全景跟拍，机位距队伍5米，主体大小不变。
Continue the eastern full-shot track about five metres from the team without pushing closer.
南入口留守人员渐出画但仍留守，前方转角为下一推进目标。
Door guards leave the frame because the camera advances, not because they disappear; the northern corner is the next objective.
前方枪声更清晰，靴声与衣料摩擦持续，无配乐。
Forward gunfire becomes clearer under boots and fabric movement; no music.
黄征到北侧转角前，队长仍后两米，队伍已在楼内。
End just before the northern corner, with the team already inside and 队长 still behind.

title: 向楼顶推进
task: 用有标识的时间省略交代逐层压缩退路，不能十五秒跑完五十层。
end: 头目已穿过天台门，黄征与队长抵达门内；其他警员守后方。
cuts: 5秒、10秒分别切到更高楼层，均为明确时间省略而非连续实时上楼。
segments: 黄征在转角掩护队伍推进，队长在后；远处两名无独立面部要求的匪徒在掩体后向通道开火并后撤，双方射击方向与掩体对应。
黄征 covers the team from the corner with 队长 behind; two anonymous gunmen farther north fire from cover down the corridor and retreat, keeping weapons aimed at their actual opponents.
东侧中远景固定，双方与通路都能看见，主要人物全身约画高30%，无需看清远处匪徒面部。
Hold an eastern medium-long view that includes both sides and the route, principal full figures about thirty percent of height; distant extras need no facial detail.
两方隔着通道与门框，枪口不跳向无关方向。
Doorframes separate the opposing sides; muzzle directions never jump to unrelated targets.
混响枪声、碎屑轻落、队伍脚步；无新增命令对白。
Reverberant gunfire, small falling debris and moving boots; no invented spoken orders.
对方退向楼梯，黄征准备跟进。
The opposition retreats toward the stairs; 黄征 prepares to follow.
明确省略中间楼层后，队伍出现在更高层楼梯。贩毒头目沿上行楼梯退走，黄征与队长向上追，其他警员封住下方通路。
After an explicit ellipsis over intermediate floors, the team is on a higher staircase. 贩毒头目 retreats upward; 黄征 and 队长 pursue while other officers secure the lower route.
切到楼梯东侧全景，阶梯和上下平台同见；主要人物不超过画高35%，不特写楼层数字。
Cut to a full view from the east of the stairs, including both landings and the ascending route; principal figures stay below thirty-five percent of height; no floor-number insert.
头目居上，黄征中间，队长后方；这不是同一时刻瞬移。
The boss is above, 黄征 in the middle and 队长 behind; the cut signals elapsed time, not teleportation.
楼梯间急促脚步回荡，下方零星枪声渐弱。
Hurried stairwell footsteps reverberate while scattered shots below fade.
仍在上行追赶，头目未被抓。
The upward pursuit continues; the boss remains uncaptured.
再次明确时间省略至顶层，贩毒头目推过天台门出画，黄征和队长先后到门内，后方警员留守。
A second explicit ellipsis reaches the top landing. 贩毒头目 passes through the roof door and exits view; 黄征 and 队长 arrive inside it while officers stay behind.
切到门内东侧全景，平视见人物全身、最后楼梯和门，白昼从门外射入。
Cut to an eastern full view of the final stairs and roof door; daylight enters from outside and the full bodies remain visible.
门在北前方，后方通路保持有人控制。
The exit is ahead to the north; the route behind remains secured.
门轴响，风声接替室内枪声成为主环境声，脚步不停。
Door hinges creak; outdoor wind takes over from indoor gunfire while footsteps continue.
黄征到门槛内，队长随其后，头目在屋顶。
黄征 ends just inside the threshold with 队长 behind and the boss outside.

title: 天台建立关系
task: 同时交代目标、掩体、出口和南缘坠落危险。
start: 黄征在西侧出口内，队长其后，头目已在北侧机组。
end: 黄征朝北对峙，背后南缘低围挡距半步；队长在其西南侧后方，头目在北机组。
cuts: 连续空间建立，无切镜；队长沿西侧后方移动，不穿过枪线。
segments: 黄征从西侧出口进入屋顶，转向北侧机组后的贩毒头目；队长随后出门，两人不沿同一枪线重叠。
黄征 enters through the western roof exit and faces 贩毒头目 at the northern HVAC cover; 队长 follows without standing on the same firing line.
从东侧约15米处全景，平视，三人全身约画高20%，同时保留出口、机组、南围挡与城市。
An eye-level wide full shot from the east, about fifteen metres away; full figures occupy twenty percent of height with exit, HVAC, southern parapet and skyline visible.
西出口、北机组、南边缘建立固定地标。
Establish the fixed western exit, northern HVAC bank and southern edge.
强风吹动衣服，脚步与金属设备低鸣，无对白。
Strong wind flaps clothing over footsteps and low mechanical hum; no dialogue.
两名警察已出门，头目仍北侧掩体。
Both officers are on the roof; the boss stays at northern cover.
头目在机组边举枪形成正面压力，黄征保持朝北持枪，借机组视线角度向南后退两小步；队长沿西侧随行，仍位于侧后方。

The boss aims from the HVAC edge, maintaining frontal pressure. 黄征 keeps facing north and retreats two small steps south to maintain his line of sight; 队长 follows on the western side, staying behind him.
东侧机位平移跟随，继续全景，保持三人相对位置与南边缘可见，不推进脸。
Track laterally on the east in the same full framing, preserving all three positions and the southern edge rather than moving into faces.
黄征后退接近低围挡；队长在西南斜后约2米，不挡南向退路。
黄征 nears the low parapet; 队长 is roughly two metres southwest behind him, leaving the due-south fall path clear.
衣料急促摩擦、风掠围挡，枪击未发生。
Fabric rustles against the wind crossing the parapet; no betrayal shot yet.
黄征距南围挡半步，队长固定西南斜后。
黄征 is half a step from the southern parapet and 队长 settles southwest behind him.
黄征稳住枪口看向北侧头目，仍将后方托付同伴；队长停止移动，尚未开枪，头目维持掩护。
黄征 steadies his aim on the northern boss, still trusting the teammate behind him. 队长 stops moving without firing; the boss maintains cover.
同一东侧全景固定，南围挡、三人和北机组都可辨，动作关系比表情细节重要。
Lock the eastern full view; parapet, all three people and northern cover remain readable; spatial relationships matter more than micro-expressions.
队长在黄征后方偏西，不与头目重叠。
队长 remains behind and west of 黄征, distinct from the boss.
风声连续、低沉呼吸，无重复枪声。
Wind and low breathing continue, without repeated gunshots.
对峙未解，朝向、持物和位置保持至下一镜。
The standoff remains unresolved; preserve positions, weapons and orientations into the next clip.

title: 身后的枪口
task: 揭示背叛；只能由队长现有位置开一枪。
start: 黄征朝北，队长西南侧后，头目北机组。
end: 黄征受击仍站立，无法正常发声，尚未回头确认。
cuts: 0秒接东侧关系画面；5秒切东南侧中景突出侧后方枪口，但保留两警察及南围挡。
segments: 延续对峙，黄征枪口指北，队长仍在西南侧后，没有绕行或转身，头目在北机组掩体。
Continue the standoff: 黄征 aims north, 队长 remains southwest behind him without turning or circling, and the boss stays at northern HVAC cover.
承接东侧全景，保持南边缘和所有目标关系。
Continue the eastern full framing, retaining the southern edge and all targeting relationships.
三人位置不重置，队长与黄征间无障碍。
Positions do not reset; there is no obstruction between 队长 and 黄征.
强风与紧绷呼吸，不用配乐预告动作。
Strong wind and tense breathing; no musical cue invents an action.
队长开始握紧枪，黄征注意力仍朝北。
队长 begins tightening his grip while 黄征 still looks north.
队长就在原处抬枪，枪口对准黄征后背；黄征继续面对前方，不提前发现。
From the same position, 队长 raises his pistol toward 黄征’s back; 黄征 continues facing forward and does not discover the betrayal early.
切到东南侧约5米的膝上双人中景，两人不重叠，保留低围挡；头目在远背景或画外北侧。

Cut to a southeast medium two-shot about five metres away, framed from knees upward; keep the two officers separate and the low parapet visible, with the boss at northern cover in the distance or offscreen.
子弹方向由西南斜向东北，撞击后人物失衡退南，不把弹道当巨大冲力。
The shot line runs southwest to northeast; the subsequent loss of balance leads south, not a physically exaggerated bullet-driven launch.
握枪衣料轻响，风声持续。
Soft sleeve movement accompanies the raised pistol under continuous wind.
队长枪口已稳对后背，尚未扣扳机。
队长 has aimed at the back but has not yet pulled the trigger.
队长扣动扳机，仅一枪；子弹从黄征后背穿入、胸前穿出，以衣料破损与短促血迹交代，不展示器官。
队长 fires exactly once; the bullet enters 黄征’s back and exits through the chest, conveyed by damaged fabric and a brief blood mark without exposed organs.
维持双人中景，不切伤口特写，枪口与受击者同时可辨。
Hold the medium two-shot, keeping shooter and victim readable without a wound close-up.
队长没有向别处射击，黄征仍朝北。
队长 fires at the established target, not elsewhere; 黄征 still faces north.
一声骤响盖过风声，随后短回声。
One abrupt gunshot overwhelms the wind, followed by a short echo.
黄征受击，未跌落。
黄征 is struck but has not fallen.
黄征身体一僵，前举手臂下沉，呼吸骤断，身体仍朝北，注意力开始转向身后；队长继续指着他。
黄征 stiffens, his raised arms sink and his breath catches; his torso remains northward while attention shifts behind him. 队长 keeps the pistol trained on him.
双人中景保持，不追加推脸或重播枪击。
Keep the same two-shot without pushing into a face or replaying the shot.
南围挡仍在黄征身后半步，头目没有突然换位。
The southern parapet remains half a step behind 黄征; the boss does not change position without cause.
回声消散后风声恢复，黄征只有破碎呼吸，无台词。
As the echo decays the wind returns; 黄征 produces broken breathing but no words.
黄征还站着、枪手在其侧后，下一镜才回头看清。
He is still standing with the shooter behind him; visual confirmation happens next.

title: 回头确认与坠落
task: 保留扭头、说不出话与仰面越过围挡的因果。
start: 受击站立，队长西南侧后。
end: 黄征仰面离开南缘，队长仍屋顶，坠落已开始但漩涡未出现。
cuts: 0秒从东南中景续接；5秒切东侧全景展现失衡路径；10秒沿东侧跟随越缘，不越轴。
segments: 黄征躯干仍大体朝北，艰难向左后扭头，看清西南侧队长仍对准自己的枪口；嘴唇想动却说不出话，队长不转身。

With his torso still broadly northward, 黄征 painfully looks back over his left shoulder and sees 队长’s pistol still trained on him to the southwest. His lips attempt a word but no speech emerges; 队长 does not turn.
东南侧中景略横移以看清回头关系，人物真实转头由受击确认动机驱动，不强行拧身到正面。
From the southeast medium view, shift slightly laterally to clarify the backward look; the head turn is motivated by discovering the shooter, not by showing a face to camera.
侧后方枪手与黄征视线相交，头目仍北方掩体。
His backward eyeline meets the shooter; the boss remains at northern cover.
喘息断续，枪声不重播，只有屋顶风声。
Broken breath and rooftop wind, with no repeated gunshot.
黄征已看清背叛者，脚下支撑开始丧失。
He has identified the betrayer and begins losing support.
黄征回头后的身体失衡，向南踉跄，腿后撞到低围挡，重心逐渐向围挡外倾；队长原地保持瞄准。
黄征 loses balance after the backward look, staggers south and catches the back of his legs against the low parapet; his centre of mass tips outward. 队长 maintains aim from his position.
切东侧全景，头脚和围挡完整，约画高40%，展示实际失足而非被子弹弹飞。
Cut to an eastern full shot with head, feet and parapet visible, about forty percent frame height, showing a loss of balance rather than a bullet throwing him.
南向坠落路线无遮挡，队长在西侧不挡路。
The southward fall path is unobstructed; 队长 remains west of it.
鞋底擦地、腿撞围挡、衣料摩擦，风声增强。
Scraping soles, contact with concrete and fabric friction under rising wind.
上半身越过围挡，尚有腿部接触。
His upper body tips beyond the parapet while his legs still touch it.
黄征仰面越出南缘，双脚离开天台，开始下坠；队长和枪口留在上方屋顶，他没有重新站起或抓住边缘。
黄征 tips backward beyond the southern edge, his feet leave the roof and the fall begins. 队长 and the pistol remain above; he neither stands again nor catches the edge.
从东侧全景平滑跟随向下，楼体和高空落差可见，不进入脸部特写。
Follow downward smoothly from the eastern full view, retaining facade and height instead of cutting to a facial close-up.
身体朝天，城市在下方，屋顶远离；头目不离开北机组去追。
His front faces the sky, the city lies below and the rooftop recedes; the boss does not abandon cover to pursue him.
风噪盖过天台声，没有撞地声或漩涡声。
Rushing air overtakes rooftop sound; no impact or vortex sound yet.
已离屋顶仰面下坠，下一镜接同一次坠落。
He is falling face upward; the next clip continues this same fall.

title: 落地异变与睁眼
task: 完成一次坠落，在落地瞬间切断意识，再出现独立古代身体；两身份先后不同时。
end: 华雄已在马上睁眼，右手持红缨长枪，左手缰绳。
cuts: 0–7秒主观延时感受而非额外物理滞空；7秒落地感知与黑暗衔接；9秒明确时空及身体切换。
segments: 黄征延续仰面下坠，楼顶在上方远去，受伤后仍无法喊话；以主观延时感受表现恐惧，不再次从屋顶掉下。
黄征 continues the same face-up fall, the roof receding above; he cannot call out. Subjectively stretched time conveys fear rather than another fall from the roof.
楼外东侧远景顺势下降，人物全身约画高15%，立面构成纵深；没有脸部凝视段。
An exterior eastern long view follows downward; the full figure occupies fifteen percent of height against the deep facade, with no prolonged face insert.
人物在南立面外，屋顶和地面距离连续变化。
He remains outside the southern facade as distances to roof and ground change continuously.
尖锐风噪、模糊心跳，头顶的声音远去。
Harsh rushing wind and muffled heartbeat as sounds above recede.
接近地面但未出现漩涡。
He approaches the ground; no vortex has appeared.
下坠抵达落地瞬间，眼前才出现强烈黑色漩涡朝自己卷来；这是主观所见，不给出客观传送装置。
Only at the instant of reaching the ground does a fierce black vortex seem to surge toward him; this is subjective perception, not an objective teleportation device.
切主观感知，卷动黑暗侵入原先的天空与楼影；不展示新的身体姿势。
Cut to subjective perception as churning darkness overtakes the sky and tower silhouette; do not invent a new body pose.
空间由现实坠落转为意识视觉，不能把漩涡放回高空。
Real falling space gives way to perception; do not relocate the vortex high in the air.
风噪压成低频卷动声，不增加尸体撞击细节。
Rushing wind compresses into a low swirling roar without graphic impact detail.
黄征开始闭眼接受未知命运。
黄征 begins closing his eyes to the unknown.
黄征闭眼，意识被黑暗截断，不解释死亡、救援或穿越能力。
黄征 closes his eyes; darkness interrupts consciousness without explaining death, rescue or supernatural powers.
主观黑场自然闭合，不字幕、不闪回枪击。
The subjective image closes to black naturally, without text or a replay of the shooting.
此段无可见角色，不混合两张脸。
No character is visible during the blackout; never blend the two faces.
卷动声消退，先听到马呼吸与缰具轻响。
The swirling sound fades; horse breathing and faint tack become audible first.
黑场末已建立新声场，未出现旧身体。
The new soundscape is established before the new body is shown.
明确进入古代：华雄已骑在高头大马上，眼睛闭着，右手持红缨长枪、左手缰绳；意识醒转，身体不是现代警察。
Enter antiquity explicitly: 华雄 is already mounted on a tall horse, eyes closed, red-tasselled spear in his right hand and reins in his left. Consciousness returns in this distinct ancient body.
切战场东侧全景，人与马全身约画高35%，显示烈日与开阔地面；不从现代脸变形过去。
Cut to an eastern battlefield full view, rider and horse together about thirty-five percent frame height, showing blazing sun and open ground; no facial morph from the modern man.
马面北站立，人物始终在鞍上，远处有小规模不可辨面部的军阵。
The horse stands facing north; the rider is already seated, with distant faceless ranks at the sides.
马鼻息、皮革轻响、旷野风声，无对白。
Horse breathing, faint leather creaks and open-country wind; no dialogue.
华雄在鞍上开始睁眼，枪缰未换手。
华雄 begins opening his eyes without swapping spear or reins.
华雄睁眼迎着刺目日光，感到坐骑轻微起伏，右手枪尖反光，尚未见挑战者。
华雄 opens his eyes to harsh daylight and feels the horse shift beneath him; his spear point catches the sun, before any challenger is revealed.
维持东侧全景，不推近，身份靠外貌轮廓与甲胄辨识，不要求眼部微细节。
Keep the eastern full view without a push-in; identity reads through silhouette and armour rather than minute eye detail.
北方开阔冲锋地在前，马仍原地。
The northern charging ground remains ahead and the horse stays put.

Nearby leather friction and indistinct distant ranks, with no new intelligible line.

title: 枪锋将至
